name: Biology PhD
summary: Biology doctoral research spanning ecology, evolution, conservation and wildlife, and molecular, cellular and developmental biology.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. No single admission model is assigned because faculty advisor agreement is required but prior contact is not mandatory.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application and teaching-assistantship consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated. Submit all materials before the deadline. University international fall deadline is May1, but earlier program deadline controls.

applicationFee.note: Non-refundable fee required for each application; no application-fee waivers available.

english.toefl: 4.0 on the published current graduate scale
english.note: IELTS within the last three years. English proficiency may also be satisfied by a qualifying degree in a listed country or approved ELS study; central country list governs degree exemption. Central policy additionally requires TOEFL speaking 26/30 for Graduate Teaching Assistantship consideration; the page does not state a new-scale equivalent, so confirm rather than convert.

documents: Official transcripts from every college/university attended
requirements.note: Bachelor’s or master’s entry. GPA 3.0 for master’s work; bachelor-only applicants need2.75 overall or 3.0 junior/senior credits. Strong biology background required; undergraduate deficiencies cannot be made up within the graduate program. Advisor agreement needed for admission, although prior faculty contact is not required. WES evaluation desired where possible.

funding.note: Teaching/research assistantships, fellowships and internships are competitive. Teaching assistantships may be renewed for satisfactory progress/service; most offers begin in early March. Tuition waivers are not guaranteed.
